description_en: Queries information about users that are authorized to access a database instance by using the secure access proxy feature
description_zh: 获取安全访问代理的授权列表
name: ListProxyAccesses

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the secure access proxy. 

You can call the ListProxies (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/listproxies) operation to query the ID of the secure access proxy
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问代理ID。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295371.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: proxy_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant. 

You can call the GetUserActiveTenant (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/getuseractivetenant) operation to query the ID of the tenant
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: tid
